exposure: Various obstetric practices during labor and childbirth
outcome: Prevalence of good and interventional obstetric practices during labor and childbirth
cohort: 314 women who gave birth at a tertiary hospital between July 2017 and July 2018
finding: While the study found a high prevalence of good practices like timely cord clamping, immediate skin-to-skin contact, and breastfeeding in the delivery room, interventional practices like venoclysis and oxytocin infusion were still prevalent.
